description: A human-in-the-loop view of the existing SYN application. The original booking and hotels units still provide IMAP intake, conversation processing, generated follow-ups, SMTP delivery and hotel matching. Their facades are hidden in this composition and replaced by the Mail Desk unit's swimlanes. Moving a generated draft to Waiting for user response marks that artifact approved; the unchanged booking dispatcher then sends it, files the outbound message and advances the conversation. The card remains in review until that succeeds.
